adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` `save()`, the client sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, but the server controller (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) overrides blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. After `host.save(props)` resolves, the component ignores any server-returned `category_id` and forcibly does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. If `categoryId` was `null`/blank (e.g., new host with no selection), this sets `category` to `undefined` even though the server saved it to uncategorized, so the UI won’t reflect the server default.
